title: probe-environment context output path guard

summary.behavior: Before creating the repository .local root or writing context.json, the environment probe fails closed unless the target stays beneath the repository root and involves no reparse-point target or ancestor; existing ancestors must be real directories. Missing leaves remain allowed because the tool legitimately creates them.

scope: tools-only gate hardening; no product/schema/DSP/driver change; identity-free probe output semantics unchanged
